# Kick script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (`cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## kick.ban

Bans a viewer from your Kick chat for good. Fails when you are not signed in to Kick or the user cannot be found.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `user` | The Kick user name (a leading @ is fine) or their number id, like "CoolViewer42". |
| `reason` | Optional. Why they were banned, like "Spam". |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.ban", new { user = "CoolViewer42", reason = "Spam" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.ban", user="CoolViewer42", reason="Spam")
    ```

## kick.deleteMessage

Deletes one message from your Kick chat. Fails when the message id is empty.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `messageId` | The id of the chat message, like the %messageId% of a chat trigger. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.deleteMessage", new { messageId = "a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.deleteMessage", messageId="a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab")
    ```

## kick.getBroadcaster

Gives you the details of your Kick account and bot account as Cuebot knows them right now. Values are empty when you are not signed in.

**Gives back:** An object with broadcastUser, broadcastUserId, broadcasterChannelSlug, broadcasterIsLive, broadcasterTitle, broadcasterCategory, broadcasterViewerCount, botUser and botUserId.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.getBroadcaster");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.getBroadcaster")
    ```

## kick.getUserInfo

Looks up a Kick viewer's profile and channel. Fails when the user cannot be found.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `user` | The Kick user name (a leading @ is fine) or their number id, like "CoolViewer42". |

**Gives back:** An object with user, userName, userId, profilePicture, channelSlug, isLive, streamTitle, category and description.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.getUserInfo", new { user = "CoolViewer42" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.getUserInfo", user="CoolViewer42")
    ```

## kick.reply

Replies to a message in your Kick chat. Long text is split into several messages; only the first one is the reply.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `message` | What to say, like "Thanks for asking!" |
| `replyTo` | The id of the message to answer, like the %messageId% of a chat trigger. |
| `useBot` | Optional. true sends it with your bot account. Leave it out to send as yourself. |
| `fallback` | Optional. With useBot, true (the default) sends as yourself when the bot is not signed in; false makes it fail instead. |

**Gives back:** The id of the message that was sent last, or null when the message was empty.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.reply", new { message = "Thanks for asking!", replyTo = "a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.reply", message="Thanks for asking!", replyTo="a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab")
    ```

## kick.sendMessage

Sends a message in your Kick chat. Long text is split into several messages. Fails when you are not signed in to Kick.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `message` | What to say, like "Welcome to the stream!" |
| `useBot` | Optional. true sends it with your bot account. Leave it out to send as yourself. |
| `fallback` | Optional. With useBot, true (the default) sends as yourself when the bot is not signed in; false makes it fail instead. |

**Gives back:** The id of the message that was sent last, or null when the message was empty.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.sendMessage", new { message = "Welcome to the stream!" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.sendMessage", message="Welcome to the stream!")
    ```

## kick.setCategory

Changes the category of your Kick stream. A name picks the exact match, or else the first search result. Fails when nothing matches.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `category` | The category name, like "Just Chatting", or its number id. |

**Gives back:** The name of the category that was set.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.setCategory", new { category = "Just Chatting" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.setCategory", category="Just Chatting")
    ```

## kick.setTitle

Changes the title of your Kick stream. Fails when the title is empty.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | The new title, like "Chill games with chat". |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.setTitle", new { title = "Chill games with chat" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.setTitle", title="Chill games with chat")
    ```

## kick.timeout

Times out a viewer in your Kick chat. Kick counts in whole minutes, so seconds are rounded up (1 minute to 7 days).

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `user` | The Kick user name (a leading @ is fine) or their number id, like "CoolViewer42". |
| `seconds` | Optional. How long, in seconds, like 300. Leave it out for 300 (5 minutes). |
| `reason` | Optional. Why they were timed out, like "Calm down". |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.timeout", new { user = "CoolViewer42", seconds = 300, reason = "Calm down" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.timeout", user="CoolViewer42", seconds=300, reason="Calm down")
    ```

## kick.unban

Lets a banned or timed-out viewer chat on Kick again.

| Value | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| `user` | The Kick user name (a leading @ is fine) or their number id, like "CoolViewer42". |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("kick.unban", new { user = "CoolViewer42" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.call("kick.unban", user="CoolViewer42")
    ```
